clientFunction.name: update_storefront_ui
clientFunction.description: Synchronizes the main Cymbal Telecom web storefront UI across the Care-to-Converged-Bundle customer journey: account_diagnostics (Live Diagnostics & £12.00 Instant Refund Confirmed banner), tailored_bundle_showcase (GEOFF'S TAILORED HOME BUNDLE 3-pillar showcase), mesh_coverage_map (Illustrative 4-bedroom Home Wi-Fi Mesh Coverage diagram), and checkout_and_servicenow (1-Click Multi-Product Order Confirmation + ServiceNow INC-904821 card). Call this tool silently in the same step as backend tools (passing view directly) without emitting a spoken filler phrase before the tool call.

view.description: Required target storefront view state: 'account_diagnostics', 'tailored_bundle_showcase', 'mesh_coverage_map', or 'checkout_and_servicenow'.

view_mode.description: Optional sub-view toggle used by mesh_coverage_map: 'after_mesh_coverage' (default showing Smart Hub 3 + 3 Mesh Discs in Hallway, Kitchen-Diner, and Upstairs Landing), 'before_dead_zones' (showing Smart Hub 2 red dead zones), 'upstairs_gaming_view', or 'hybrid_4g_failover'.

payload_json.description: Optional structured JSON string with view-specific telemetry, 3-pillar bundle details, coverage nodes, or basket and ServiceNow INC-904821 confirmation details.

status.description: Confirmation that the main Cymbal Telecom web storefront UI updated to the requested view.

active_view.description: The storefront view now displayed to the customer.
